title: Laura
body:
Description

Laura, the owner of Flora Laura in the Flowering Meadows, is the go-to girl for all your Oaklands flowering and floral needs. Whether you're in need of flowers, dyes, vases, or nets to catch butterflies, her shop is always open and welcoming to anyone!

Appearance

Laura has colorful purple and pink hair. She is dressed in a white shirt with flowery purple overalls that are paired with long grey jeans and white shoes.

Dialogue

"All of your flower needs!" - Interaction Prompt

When no items are placed on the counter:

  • "Hi! Welcome to Flora Laura. We have a wide selection of all your decor needs!"
    • Okay! (Ends conversation)

When an item is placed on the counter:

  • "Are you sure you want to buy [Item_Name] for [Total_Price]? Your items will go down the hatch!"
    • Absolutely! (Item is purchased)
    • No thank you. (Ends conversation)

When an item (s) is placed on the counter, but you don't have enough money to purchase it:

  • "Sorry, you don't have enough money for this."
    • No thank you. (Ends conversation)
    • Buy Money (Opens Robux shop to Cash Section)
